tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi skor bzhugs// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dang pa rnams la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul bsam yas bir+wa pa// mtha' yas rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// shes bya kun rig rje btsun bsod nams brtse// bdag nyid chen po rje btsun rin po che// bstan pa'i sgron me sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mkhas grub chen po tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal// dus gsum gzigs pa'i nyan chen bsod nams brtan// rlung sems dbang 'byor chos rje brag phug pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa// snyan rgyud gdams pa'i bdag po dpal ldan pa// chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun bud+dha shrī// bka' drin mnyam med kun dga'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// ngo mtshar sprul pa'i ya mtshan kun bsdus nas// bkod legs mdzes sdug brjid pa'i khri stengs su// 'od 'bar nyi zla'i zhabs rten nyams dga' bar// brtse chen bla ma rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje rnam gsum khyod kyi sku gsung thugs// rgyal ba rigs lnga khyod kyi phung po lnga// yum chen rnam bzhi khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi// dngos kun byin rlob nges par 'khor lo'i mgon// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// khro chen rnam bcu khyod kyi tshigs chen bcu// rgyal sras rnam brgyad nang gi skye mched du// rim par sprul nas yul la longs spyod cing*// ma lus bgegs dpung 'joms mdzad 'khor lo'i bdag /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin lhun grub bcos min pho brang du// ma lus rigs kyi bdag po'i skur bstan nas// snod bcud ma lus rigs brgya'i rnam rol du// nges par gzigs nas rigs par 'doms mdzad pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// skal bzang phar phyin theg pas smin mdzad nas// zung 'jug bde stong lam gyis grol mdzad pa// phrin las dbang po rje btsun bla ma nyid// nges par 'jam pa'i rdo rjer mthong gyur nas// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul pa dang*// 'jig rten khams na bdag pos ma bzung ba'i// dngos kun dmigs med ngang nas 'bul lag kyi// bdag gir zhen pa spong bar byin gyis rlobs// thog me'i las dang nyon mongs kyis sprul pa'i// ma dag phung po bdag tu 'khrul pa'i gzhi// zag med bdud rtsi'i ngo bor byin brlabs pa// chos dbyings ngang nas khyod la 'phul lags kyi// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs// stong nyid rdo rjes nges par rgyas btab pa'i// zag med bde ba chen po'i mchod pa ni// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'bul// bde stong ye shes 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan bla ma'i rdo rje rnam gsum po// bdag gi lus ngag yid la zhugs gyur nas// dbang bzhi'i lam gyis sgrib kun dag gyur te// sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di ni rdo rje yi// slob ma 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor// gser mdog can gyi chos kyi grwar// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis so// maṅgalaṃ/// /

༄༅// na maḥgu ru we/ gsang sngags bla med kyi dbang bskur phyin ci ma log par thob pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la/ don bzhi ste/ bla ma sgom pa/ zhen pa spang ba/ dngos grub blang ba/ bla ma'i thugs khar 'pho ba'o// dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i khri'i steng du/ pad ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma thams cad bsdus pa'i ngo bor sgom pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po/ phyi nang gsang ba thams cad chos dbyings kyi ngo bor mos shing*/ byin gyis brlabs nas phul te/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// sogs kyi bstod pas bstod do// gsum pa ni/ bla ma de'i gnas gsum nas/ rang gi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ka rnams su 'od zer dkar dmar sngo gsum 'phros shing*/ thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pas dri ma mtha' dag dag par bsam mo// bzhi pa ni/ rang gi gnas lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba lcag tsam/ drang thal le ba/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga rgya mthong kha phye ba lta bu yod pa la thug par bsam/ de'i nang*/ snying kha'i thad/ zla ba'i steng du/ rang gi sems rig pa'i ngo bo 'od kyi rang bzhin can sran dkar ma'i tshad tsam zhig bsam zhing yun ring du bsgom/ 'og rlung gyen du drangs pa'i rkyen gyis/ sems nyid 'od kyi gong bu de tshangs bug nas thon/ bla ma'i thugs khar thim/ slar yang thugs kha nas 'thon/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ zla gdan la 'khod/ slar yang snga ma bzhin du lan nyer gcig byas te/ mthar zla gdan la bzhag spyi bo za ba sogs byung na grub pa'i tshad yin pas/

ma brjed tsam ma gtogs yang dang yang du mi bya/ 'di ni tshe sgrub kyi'ang mchog tu 'gyur ro zhes gsung*// ༈ //gshed dmar spros med kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa gnyis med ye shes 'char byed ces pa bzhugs// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ gnyis med ye shes bde ba chen po yis// gzung 'dzin gshin rje mthar mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs// spros med ngang las g.yo ba med bzhin du// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar mdzad bir+wa pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// nyon mongs dug lnga'i ngo bo 'od gsal du// nye bar zhi mdzad rje btsun ḍoṃ bhi pa// phyi nang chos kun sgyu ma'i rnam rol du// mngon sum gzigs pa grub chen dpal 'dzin zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis khyod la mngon sum du// legs par 'doms mdzad blo bzang snying po'i mtshan// phyi nang chos kun rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor du// ji bzhin gzigs mdzad dar+pan ā tsar+ya// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang phyug lo tsā ba// kun la bsnyengs bral shes rab rin chen zhabs// gshin rje gshed po'i rim gnyis rnal 'byor mchog /phyogs 'dir sngon med gsal ba'i bka' drin can// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snyan brgyud gdams pa mang po'i mdzod bzung nas// thugs rje che ldan 'gro mgon sa pa'i mtshan// mdo dang sngags kyi dbang phyug lo tsā ba// mkhyen rab dbang phyug legs pa'i blo gros zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dbang dang gdams pa mang pos gdul bya rnams// smin zhing grol mdzad dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs// bstan pa rin chen 'ba' zhig nyer dgongs pa// kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston rin chen grub// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'jam dbyangs 'khon gyi gdung 'dzin sa skya pa// mkhyen rab dbang po bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// zab mo'i don gzigs rig pa'i gnas lnga la// mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mdo rgyud kun sbyangs shin tu spros med kyi// rnal 'byor grub pa ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs// chos rnams kun gyi yin lugs legs mkhyen nas// ma nor ston mdzad kun dga' bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// stong nyid blo dang kun rdzob byang chub sems// zung 'jug mngon gyur dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// gnyis med chos la ji bzhin nges rnyed pa// blo gsal dbang po mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// brgya phrag bsod nams tshogs las legs 'khrungs pa'i// rgyal tshab mtshan ldan sems dpa' chen po dang*// skye med rang gsal ji bzhin nges snyed pa'i// mgon des rjes bzung bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// brgyud pa kun 'dus byin rlabs yongs kyi mdzod// bka' drin gnyis med rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dbang brgyud man ngag chos kyi 'brel thob pa'i// bla mar gyur pa'i skyes mchog thams cad la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gzung 'dzin gnyis snang stong par sbyangs byas nas// gnyis med ye shes lhag pa'i lha goms pas// tha mal snang zhen rtog pa ji snyed dang*// nyon mongs dug lnga rang sar dag gyur cig

/dkon mchog gsum bsdus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// lus dang longs spyod bdog pa kun phul bas// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa rang sar dag gyur nas// gnyis med ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gang shar snang ba sems su thag chod nas// gzung bya'i yul la zhen pa log pa dang*// 'dzin byed blo yang 'khrul par go byas nas// rang rig rang gsal 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// shin tu spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma rgyud pa la gsol ba btab nas/ gnyis med kyi ye shes 'char byed ces bya ba/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan no/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ //ni gu brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ bde chen dbyings las mi g.yo zung 'jug sku// sna tshogs sprul sku'i rnam rol bgrang yas kyis// khyab bdag 'khor lo sgyur ba rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi rgya mtsho las// zab gsal gnyis med sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs nas// dga' bzhi'i dpal rab ster mdzad ni gu ma// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thun mong dngos grub bsnyes nas ye shes kyi// mkha' 'gros rjes bzung zab lam du ma'i mdzod// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa khyung po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snang stong sgyu ma'i sku la dbang 'byor nas// bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i rnam rol gyis// nyin mtshan dus 'da' grub chen rmog cog pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i rnam sprul gyis// gang 'dul 'gro kun dag pa'i zhing dag tu// 'dren mdzad chos kyi mdzod 'dzin skyer sgang pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// kun rdzob snang ba sems su thag chod cing*// sems kyang sgyu ma'i rnam rol du gzigs nas// sgyu lus mtshan dpes spras pa'i gnyan ston pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gang shar snang ba rmi lam ngo bor mkhyen// rmi lam 'od gsal ngang du byang chub nas// mtshan 'dzin dbyings su zhi mdzad ston pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// spros pa'i tshogs kun 'khrul pa'i snang bar mkhyen// 'khrul snang mtha' dag rmi lam ngo bor gzigs// rmi lam longs skur 'char mdzad gzhon nu grub// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dngos grub rtsa ba dpal ldan bla ma la// chos sku'i nges pa rnyed nas mchog dang ni// thun mong dngos grub brnyes pa'i zhang ston pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mnyam gzhag bde chen spros kun bral ba'i thugs// rjes thob snang stong sgyu mar ston pa'i gsung*// gang shar lhar gzigs ra ga brag pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin 'od gsal sprin bral nam mkha' la// gdams pa'i 'od gsal nyi ma'i zer 'phros pas// grub pa'i sa brnyes mkhas btsun gro sa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mkhyen pas srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing*// thugs rjes zhi ba'i dbyings la ma chags par// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don brtson spyang lung pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// snyan rgyud gdams pa'i yid bzhin rin chen gyis// khyod blo'i bang mdzod yangs par gnas bcas nas// srid zhi'i rgud pa sel mdzad legs pa'i blo// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'di'i phun tshogs nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon dang*// bar snang glog dang rmi lam longs spyod ltar// yun thung snying po med par legs go nas// bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// 'khor ba'i bde ba spu gri'i sor chags pa'i// sbrang rtsi'i ro ltar ji bzhin nges rnyed nas// gtan du bde ba'i go 'phang don gnyer bas// dam chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// ma rnams rtag tu 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher// bzod thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba// 'di la bsams nas snying rje chen po yis// lam gyi 'khrul ba sel bar byin gyis rlobs// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rnam rol 'di dag kun// rang rang ngo bos stong par thag chod cing*// stong nyid zhen pa'i yul las 'das mthong nas// 'khrul snang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// bum dbang las thob bskyed rim rnal 'byor gyis// tha mal snang zhen drung nas 'byin pa dang*// gsang dbang bskur nas gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyis// bde chen ye shes 'dren par byin gyis rlobs// gsum pa'i dbang las dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yis// zag med dga' bzhi'i 'byung ldog rim pa las// zung 'jug bde chen sgyu ma'i sku thob nas// chags sdang rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam ngang nas ji snyed chos rnams kun// dag pa'i zhing dang rgyal ba'i sku sprul nas// mtshan 'dzin rtog pa'i rba rlabs ci mchis pa// 'od gsal chos skur 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// sems nyid skyed de rang bzhin rnam dag pa// 'khor gsum mtshan ma'i 'ching ba las grol te// 'od gsal tshangs pa'i sgo gcig rab phye nas// don dam chos sku'i ngang du 'pho gyur gcig

/rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa'i 'char tshul kun// chos dbyings zhi ba'i ngang du thim gyur nas// bar dor longs sku sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyis// tshad med 'gro don byed par byin gyis rlobs// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //nā ro chos drug gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs// ༄// na maḥgu rā we/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i ti lo pa// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen nā ro'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gangs can bstan pa gsal mdzad mar pa'i mtshan// sgrub rgyud rgyal mtshan tshugs pa mi la'i zhabs// zla 'od gzhon nu'i rnam 'phrul sgam po pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul dus gsum mkhyen// bde stong mngon gyur 'gro mgon ras pa'i zhabs// byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i spom brag pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dbang phyug karma pa// gtum mo'i rtsal 'byongs gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum// mkhyen rab dbang phyug rang byung rdo rje'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// nyams dang rtogs pa'i dbang phyug mgon rgyal ba// mkhas grub dbang po rol pa'i rdo rje dang*// ḍā kis lung bstan mkha' spyod dbang po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'dzam gling rgyan gyur de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan// spyan snga'i mtshan can bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// mkhas grub dam pa spyang lung chos rje'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag bgrod mang gis// gang blo gting mtha' yangs par ngal bso nas// phrin las chu chen 'bebs mdzad legs pa'i blo// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus// gtum mo'i lam gyis bde drod 'bar gyur nas// 'dod chags sgrib pa rang sar dag pa dang*// rnam rtog 'od gsal ngang du thim gyur pas// gti mug dbyings su dag par byin gyis rlobs// bde stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i lus grub nas// zhe sdang dri ma rang sar dag pa dang*// snang mched thob gsum 'byung ldog rim pa yis// tshe 'dir zung 'jug chos sku 'grub par shog

/gal te thos bsam slob ma'i tshogs skyong dang*// rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang gis ma grub na// 'pho dang grong 'jug bar do'i nyams len gyis// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob shog /yang lugs gcig la sgam po pa'i rjes la/ in+t+ra budhi'i rnam 'phrul phag gru pa// rten 'brel mthar phyin rgyal ba 'bri khung pa// 'bri phag bstan pa rgyas mdzad spyan snga ba// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba thog

rgyal ba thog rdugs pa'i bcu pa/ bcu gnyis pa rin chen rdo rje sgo mangs thog mar bzhengs pa de yin/ de rjes gnyis mchod pa grags pa rin chen/ spyan snga gser theg par grags/ de rjes tshes bzhi rnying ma ba mtshan grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de rjes bcu gnyis gsar ma ba mtshan grags pa shes rab/ de rjes spyan snga bsod nams grags pa spyan snga kun spangs par grags pa dang lnga'o// rdug pa/ de nas brgyud pa'i spyan snga rnam pa lnga// nyi ma lta bur grags pa'i bsod nams mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus// zhes sogs gong ma dang sbyar// ces pa 'di yang brag dkar bas// gsol ba btab pa'i ngor byas nas// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros kyis// gser mdog can gyi chos grwar sbyar// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //sha wa ra'i sbyor drug brgyud 'debs// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dang rgyal ba'i sras// dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nyer thob pa// kun kyang bde ba chen por ngang gcig pa'i// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan rgyu skar chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// sangs rgyas nyid kyis dngos su dbang bskur nas// mchog gi dngos grub khri la rtag bzhugs pa// ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sha wa ri las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur mnos shing rnal 'byor yan lag drug /ma lus mthar phyin grub pa'i kun mkhyen pa// rin chen shākya'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs pa'i sku// stong nyid seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i gsung*// rnal 'byor yan lag drug gis phyug pa'i thugs// dpal ldan dngos grub dbang por gsol ba 'debs// legs gsungs 'dul ba'i chos tshul ma lus mkhyen// rgyud dang man ngag mang po'i pha mthar son// 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ros thub pa'i bstan// bsrung mkhas dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs// gzhon nu nyid nas thub pa'i gsung rab kun// ma lus thugs su chud pa'i blo gros kyis// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rin po che// mtshungs med chos rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi chos// pad dkar 'dzin de'i thugs las byon gyur pa// dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum ngo bo nyid// bka' drin mnyam med zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ngag gi dbang por mtshan gsol 'jam pa'i dbyangs// gzhon nur gyur pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' sgrub pas// pha rol phyin dang theg mchog rtse mo yis// don kun grub pa khyod la gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten lugs kyi gzhon nu'i ngang tshul la// nam yang mi 'jug 'phags pa chen po'i chos// zab cing rgya cher gyur rnams grub pa po// 'jigs med dbang por gyur pa gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bla ma rnams dang yid dam lha tshogs dang*// dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu dang nus pa yis// bshad bsgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/

//shu bhaṃ// ༈ //rgwa lo'i gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i rgyud 'debs bzhugs// ༄// bde ba'i dpal ster ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// chos kyi nying khu len mdzad rgwa lo'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mdo rgyud mang por lung bstan skye med zhang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de sras thu bo rgyal sras rol gang ba// gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs// ye shes nang nas grol ba'i yang dgon pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin spyan mnga' rin chen ldan// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson mdzad zur phug pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// chos kyi mdzod 'dzin ra ga grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sems dpa' chen po gro sa mkhan chen pa// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// chos la dbang 'byor mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lus gnad 'khrul pa med par byin gyis rlobs// rlung sems dbang du 'dus par byin gyis rlobs// gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //phar phyin rgyud 'debs// ༄// na mo gu rā we/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab rdzogs pa'i sku// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gsung*// rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i thugs mnga' ba// thub chen ston pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// slob ma'i tshogs rnams zhi bar 'dren pa'i gru// rgyal ba'i sras rnams srid par gnas pa'i thabs// bgrang yas rgyal ba chos kun gsung ba'i rkyen// yum gyur pha rol phyin ma la phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rje btsun mi pham mgon// thub pas lung bstan 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// kun mkhyen gnyis pa mkhas mchog dbyig gi gnyen// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dbu ma'i lam brnyes 'phags pa rnam grol sde// dad pa'i sar bzhugs btsun pa rnam grol sde// zab mo'i don mthong dpal ldan mchog gi sde// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mtshan rtog dbyings su zhi ba dul ba'i sde// gzung 'dzin gnyis med gzigs pa rnam snang mdzad// dngos smra'i ri dwags pham byed seng ge bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ye shes zhabs// yon tan mang po'i mdzod 'dzin bshes gnyen mtshan// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan rin chen bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rgyal yum bstan pa rgyas mdzad zla ba bzang*// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen brtan skyong zhabs// 'jig rten mig gcig blo ldan shes rab la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lung chos kun gyi mdzod 'dzin shes rab 'bar// sher phyin bshad srol 'dzin mdzad ar gyi mtshan// de sras mtshungs med gzhon nu tshul khrims la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// ji lta'i don la 'khrul med shes rab 'bum// ji snyed 'chad la thogs med byang chub 'bum// grub pa'i sar bzhugs 'jam pa'i rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rnam dpyod 'gran zla bral ba'i gzad rings zhabs// brtson 'grus mthar phyin rdo rje mtshan mnga' ba// ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan rin po che// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sde snod mdzod 'dzin grub pa seng ge'i zhabs// mkhas pa'i mchog gyur tshad ma'i skyes bu'i mtshan// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bu ston rin chen grub// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de sras dam pa mkhas btsun lung mang po// gangs can mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dpal// thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chos kyi rje// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// mkhas grub dam pa rje btsun don yod dpal// gzhung brgya'i dbang phyug mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// chos kyis sbrel ba'i yongs 'dzin ji snyed la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// chos kun stong par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// mtshan rtog ma lus dbyings su zhi ba dang*// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed nas// rgyu 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin 'byed par shog

/ces pa 'di ni rgyal rong bka' bcu pa bkra shis rin chen gyis kha ton du bya ba'i rim pa nyid du bskul ba'i ngor mchog ldan legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //phar phyin brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs// ༄// swasti/ rgyal yum rgya mtsho gsungs mdzad thub dbang nyid// nyid kyi rgyal tshab rje btsun mi pham mgon// mgon des rjes bzung 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// zhabs de'i gcung po mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen dang*// dang po'i srol 'byed 'phags pa grol sde'i mtshan// mtshan med thugs chud btsun pa rnam grol sde// sde yi mtha' can mchog dang dul ba gnyis// gnyis med gsungs mkhas rnam snang mdzad bzang po// bzang po'i mtha' can rgyal sras seng ge'i zhabs// zhabs zung bsten mdzad mkhas mchog yon tan bshes// bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i dbang po rin chen bzang*// bzang po'i mtha' can paṇa chen zla ba'i dpal// dpal ldan 'bum phrag gsum pa legs pa'i blo// blo ldan shes rab skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang*// dbang phyug dam pa rje btsun shes rab 'bar// 'bar ba'i blo mnga' byang chub ye shes zhabs// zhabs de'i thugs sras gzhon nu tshul khrims dpal// dpal gyi thugs mnga' shes rab 'bum gyi mtshan// mtshan 'dzin las grol mkhas mchog byang chub 'bum// 'bum phrag gzhung mkhyen 'jam pa'i rdo rjer grags// grags pa'i dbang phyug dar ma tshul khrims dang*// dwang ba'i thugs mnga' brtson 'grus rdo rje'i sku// sku gsung rab btsun khro phu rin po che// che mchog dam pa grub pa seng ge dbang*// dbang phyug mtshan ldan tshad ma'i skyes bur grags// grags pa mtha' yas bu ston rin chen grub// grub pa'i dbang phyug rin chen rnam par rgyal// rgyal sras mtshungs med g.yag sprug chos kyi rje// rje btsun dam pa rong ston chos rje'i mtshan// mtshan ldan bla ma kun mkhyen don yod dpal// dpal ldan mkhas pa'i dbang po mchog ldan sogs// phar phyin brgyud pa'i bla ma de dag la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs//

//maṅga laṃ// ༈ //tshad ma rnam 'grel nges kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs// ༄// swasti/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thugs rje'i dbang phyug phyogs kyi glang po'i zhabs// lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug mchog gi sde// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// grub pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa'i mtshan// brtson 'grus dbang phyug lha'i dbang po dang*// blo gros dbang phyug shākya blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// grags pa'i dbang phyug mkhas pa dul ba'i lha// slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po chos kyi mchog /de sras mtshungs med mkhas pa dzñā na shrī// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// phrin las dbang phyug gzhan phan bzang po dang*// skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug rngog lo'i zhabs// de sras dbang phyug khyung phrug rin chen grags// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug phywa pa'i mtshan// grags pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan gtsang nag pa// gnyal zhig jo nam mkhas pa 'od zer mgon// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'jam dbyangs shāka gzhon g.yag sde paṇa chen dang*// rin chen tshul khrims sangs rgyas chos skyong zhabs// sde bdun smra ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// rnam nges brgyud pa'i bla ma de dag la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dzñā na shrī'i rjes la// rnam 'grel rgyan mdzad mkhan dang dzā mā ri// chos 'byung sbyin dang gzi brjid go cha dang*// wa bu paṇa chen paṇa chen shākya shrī// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul paṇa chen sa skya pa// 'u yug mdo sde dpal dang nor bzang zhabs// brtson 'grus dpal dang mi pham chos kyi rje// rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun mkhyen rong po'i zhabs// de sras mtshungs med mkhas pa don yod dpal// blo gsal dbang po mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// rnam 'grel brgyud pa'i bla ma de dag la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba dang*/

'od ldan ni kho bos dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen la thos nas bshad do// yang mdo rtsa ba dang*/ chos mngon pa mdzod ni skyor mo lung pa bsod nams tshul khrims la thos nas bshad do// rje btsun byams pa'i chos phyi ma bzhi dang*/ dbu ma la 'jug pa dang*/ chos mngon pa kun las btus ni/ mkhas grub don yod dpal la thos nas bshad do// dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs lnga dang*/ 'dul ba tshig le'ur byas pa me tog phreng rgyud ni/ rong ston chos kyi rje la thos nas bshad do// de dag gi brgyud pa ni btsal sla bas 'dir ma bris so// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //karma pa rabs bdun la bstod pa// ༄// na mo bud+dhā ya/ yon tan kun rdzogs sgrib kun spangs pa'i thugs// zung 'jug bde chen yan lag bdun ldan gsung*// zhing khams rgya mtshor gzhan snang sprul pa'i sku// ston mdzad rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// bskal bzang 'di la sangs rgyas seng ge'i sgra// 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen sa ra ha// 'dzam gling yongs su dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes// phrin las lhun gyis grub la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen pa'i spyan gyis chos kun sgyu mar gzigs// brtse ba'i phyag gis 'gro kun dbang du bsdud// nus pa'i stobs kyis mi bzad bdud dpung las// rgyal mdzad pa shir grags la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung ye shes 'bar ba'i rdo rje yis// thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' rtogs gyur nas// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan nyid du// legs 'khrungs karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// mtshan rtog rba rlabs zhi ba'i chos dbyings mtshor// rnam rol mkhyen pa ye shes rdo rje dang*// thugs rje'i zhags pas 'gro kun 'khor ba las// sgrol mdzad karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// ti'i ming chos kyi rgyal po'i cod paṇa la// zhabs sen 'od dmar shar ba'i dpal yon gyis// de bzhin gshegs zhes bzang por mtshan gsol ba// mtshungs med karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// gang gis mthong na mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku// gus pas bsten na don dang ldan pa'i gsung*// sprul pas 'gro don phyogs bcur mdzad pa'i thugs// 'jigs med karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// rang byung ye shes chos kun mkhyen pa'i dpal// thugs rje'i dbang phyug chos rje'i rgyal tshab ces// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis glur blangs pa// bsnyengs bral karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// dag snang can la spyan ras gzigs kyi sku// shes rab can la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung*// mos gus can la rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs// mngon gyur karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// gti mug can la rnam snang mdzad kyi sku// chags pa can la 'od dpag med pa'i gsung*// khong khro can la mi bskyod rdo rje'i thugs// ston mdzad karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// gzhan la mi 'tshe byams pa chen po'i thugs// kun la mi gnod snying rje chen po'i gsung*// nye ring med par snyoms pa'i sku mnga' ba// dpal ldan karma pa la gsol ba 'debs// skal bzang rnams la sprul sku rgyun mi chad// phongs pa rnams la longs spyod rgyun mi chad// sangs rgyas bstan la 'phrin las rgyun mi chad// lhun grub rgyun mi chad la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bsod nams kyis// nyon mongs dug gsum rang sar dag pa dang*// rnam rtog mtshan 'dzin dbyings su zhi ba dang*// 'od gsal rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du zad pa dang*// ye shes rgya mtsho ngang gis gang ba dang*// thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gnod pa kun bsal nas// bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho 'phel zhing rgyas par shog

/bstod tshig gsol 'debs bskul byed 'khor bcas kyang*// tshe dang bsod nams rim gyis 'phel ba dang*// pha rol gnod pa med par rdzogs sangs rgyas// ma rnams don phyir myur du 'grub par shog /ces pa 'di ni sga mgu'i rigs// mtsho skyes sras po jo gdan gyis// gsol ba btab pa'i ngor byas nas// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis ni// g.yas ru gtsang gi sa yi cha// gser mdog can gyi chos grwa nas// lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas phul// //maṅga laṃ// //bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
